Can you please provide the following artifacts and any notes we should include in the SIG answers? Prefer redacted PDFs or a secure share link.
- Network architecture diagram (logical + simplified physical) — redacted version by 3/19 EOD
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok) — full package to secure share by 3/24
- ISO 27001 certificate + scope statement

- Backup & retention policy excerpt + last successful restore test date
